C0394.title: Illegal Acquisition of Personal Data to Run an 'Account Farming Factory'
C0394.summary: Police in Yingtan, Jiangxi, uncovered a case of infringing citizens' personal information. Since 2021, the suspect surnamed Xu illegally purchased over ten million real-name email accounts and passwords, used automated scripts to mass-farm accounts and raise their levels, then sold the matured accounts to minors to bypass game anti-addiction systems.
